posts.author: Invisnir
posts.body:
This game is the funniest *censored* you've ever seen. Another classic made by Invisnir on RPG maker 2003 this time, a peak game with funny dialogue, cool battles and so much more. Help Draniel and his friends to get out of the Camping School by going on a Funny Adventure. Out now on Itch.io and gamejolt.
